title: Corridor Router
summary: A payment router picks routes through a network of one-way corridors. Fix its hop-count search, add a fee-aware search, then make it hold up on a large network.
followUps: What is the time and space cost of your cheapest-route search, in terms of nodes, corridors and maxHops?
Why does a plain shortest-path search by fee give wrong answers once there is a hop limit?
You cache results between lookups. When exactly is the cache thrown away, and what would break if two threads used the router at once?
Corridors can be switched off at any moment in production. How would the router learn about it, and what happens to a payment already in flight?
What did the assistant get wrong or leave out, and how did you notice?
